full_prompt_en: A square pop-street-art portrait centers on a young man's monochrome face beneath a dense collage of bright graffiti color. He looks directly outward, with dark eyes, full brows and thick wavy black hair occupying the upper half. His pale face and dark jacket are rendered like a high-contrast printed photograph, but pieces of yellow, orange, blue, pink and green paint cross the forehead, cheeks, neck and clothing. A bold red H-shaped mark sits above one brow; smaller scribbles and partial letterlike strokes crowd the edges, none forming a reliably readable phrase. Thin red and black drips run vertically over the face, some beginning near the eyes and continuing toward the collar. The left side is busier with bright yellow and orange paperlike patches, while the right side holds hot pink and darker black marks. The face remains the clearest structure in the frame despite the noisy overlay. Jagged torn edges, scuffs, ink scratches and splattered pigment make the flat surface look built from pasted and overpainted layers. Light within the underlying portrait is frontal and graphic, with the right cheek in deeper grayscale shadow; the colored paint has its own even surface brightness rather than realistic illumination. No environmental setting is visible. The overall composition is confrontational and energetic, balancing an unwavering central gaze against saturated, distressed marks that partly erase the image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形波普街头艺术肖像把年轻男子的黑白面孔置于鲜亮涂鸦色彩的密集拼贴下。他直视画外，深眼睛、浓眉与厚卷黑发占据上半部。浅色面庞与深外套像高反差印刷照片，却有黄、橙、蓝、粉、绿颜料片穿过额头、脸颊、颈部和衣服。一道醒目的红色 H 形笔痕位于一侧眉上；边缘挤着更小涂写与残缺字母状线条，没有组成可靠可读的短语。细红与黑滴痕竖向流过面部，有些从眼睛附近开始延至领口。左边更繁忙，有亮黄与橙色纸片般色块；右边则有亮粉和更深黑痕。尽管覆盖层喧闹，面孔仍是画中最清楚的结构。锯齿状撕边、擦伤、墨线划痕和飞溅颜料使平面看似由粘贴并反复涂覆的层次组成。底层肖像的光正面而图形化，右脸颊灰阶更深；彩色颜料有自己的均匀表面亮度，不服从写实照明。看不到环境场景。整体构图直面观者而充满能量，以坚定的中央目光平衡饱和、磨旧且部分抹掉影像的痕迹。
style_prompt_en: A pop-street-art collage treatment pushes a high-contrast grayscale base through aggressive layers of lemon yellow, hot pink, orange, cyan and red. Torn paperlike blocks, spray marks, scratches, scrawls and vertical drips overlap without fully concealing the underlying value structure. Black focal contours stay sharp enough to anchor the image, while colored marks disregard conventional boundaries and cross them freely. Surface wear and misregistered fragments give the composition a pasted, overpainted quality. Illumination is largely graphic and even, with tonal drama supplied by the monochrome base and saturated color collisions. Dense activity reaches all edges but remains organized around a legible central concentration. The effect is loud, urban and deliberately distressed.
style_prompt_zh: 波普街头艺术拼贴处理把高反差灰阶底图推入柠檬黄、亮粉、橙、青与红的猛烈层叠中。撕纸般色块、喷涂、划痕、涂写和竖向滴痕重叠，却没有完全遮住底层明度结构。黑色焦点轮廓足够清晰，仍能固定画面；彩色痕迹则不顾常规边界，自由跨过。表面磨损与套位不准的碎片赋予构图粘贴并反复涂画的质感。照明大体图形化且均匀，明暗戏剧性来自单色底图与饱和色冲撞。密集活动抵达所有边缘，却仍围绕可读的中央重点组织。效果喧闹、都市化且刻意做旧。
theme_en: A monochrome young man's face overlaid with bright graffiti and paint drips
theme_zh: 一张黑白年轻男子面孔上覆盖鲜艳涂鸦与颜料滴痕
name: Mr. Brainwash
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
